text:
maria_cs: Quick pulse on Crestline QBR prep — need owners for slides (onboarding health, renewal risks, enablement handoff, exec asks). Can folks claim by EOD?

sam_se: I will take 'renewal risks + exec asks' slides. Will draft the one-paragraph risk summary.

jordan_pm: I'll own onboarding health + adoption metrics. @maria_cs can you share the relevant dashboard link?

maria_cs: Sure — dashboard: https://app.redwood/internal/dashboards/crestline-adoption (link)

maria_cs: Master deck: https://docs.google.com/crestline-qbr-deck (placeholder). I added a starter slide for onboarding health.

lee_eng: I'll add a 1-slide tech summary (latency impact + outstanding infra items). ETA tomorrow 12:00 PT.

sara_ce: Enablement will hand off the playbook and the recent onboarding recording. Uploading to drive now.

calendar-bot: Dry run scheduled: 2042-07-15 09:00 PT — invitation sent to attendees. :spiral_calendar_pad:

maria_cs: Action items (short):
- add your slide to master deck
- paste 1-paragraph renewal risk into slide notes
- link enablement playbook in slide footer
Please update by EOD so I can collate for dry run.

sam_se: +1. I'll add the paragraph and tag @dina_fp for ARR numbers.

dina_fp: Confirming ARR and renewal date: 2024-11-30. Noted a usage dip over last 4 weeks — I'll post the exact numbers in the deck notes.

jordan_pm: Can we include two short customer quotes for the success slide? @sara_ce can you pull 1–2 lines from the CSM?

sara_ce: Yep — pinging CSM now, will post quotes by EOD and attach permission notes.

maria_cs: Perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup: I’ll collate and send the dry run invite once slides are in. If anything is blocked, drop it here or DM me.

maria_cs: Checklist snippet for convenience: `- slides in master | - risk para | - enablement link | - quotes`

sam_se: I'll add a couple bullets for 'exec ask' (pricing flexibility + pilot extension).

maria_cs: Noted. If finance needs to sign off on the ask wording, @dina_fp please approve before dry run.

dina_fp: Will review and approve wording tomorrow morning.

maria_cs: Thanks all — wrapping up this thread. :eyes:
